blocks.title: Creationism
blocks.text: Creationism (“theory of intelligent design”) ke nazariye ke mutabiq tamam jandar bilkul waise hi paida kiye gaye jaise woh aaj hain. Creationists ka kehna hai ke har qisam ka jandar alag alag paida kiya gaya aur poori tareekh mein us mein koi tabdeeli nahin aayi.

blocks.title: Spontaneous generation
blocks.text: Purane zamane ke log yeh bhi samajhte the ke jandar be-jaan cheezon (non-living matter) se bhi ban sakte hain. Is khayal ko spontaneous generation (khud-ba-khud paida hona) kaha jata tha. Science ki taraqqi ke saath tajurbaat (experiments) ne spontaneous generation ko ghalat sabit kar diya, lekin yeh tajurbaat creationism ko ghalat sabit nahin kar sake.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Dono khayalat evolution se mukhtalif hain: creationism kehta hai ke jandar kabhi nahin badle, aur spontaneous generation kehta hai ke jandar be-jaan cheezon se ban jate hain. Tajurbaat ne sirf doosre khayal ko ghalat sabit kiya.

blocks.prompt: Tajurbaat ne kis khayal ko ghalat sabit kiya: creationism ya spontaneous generation?
blocks.explanation: Spontaneous generation ko, yaani is khayal ko ke jandar be-jaan cheezon se ban jate hain. Yeh tajurbaat creationism ko ghalat sabit nahin kar sake.

items: Creationism: har jandar alag alag apni aaj ki shakal mein paida kiya gaya aur kabhi nahin badla.
Spontaneous generation: be-jaan cheezon se zindagi; science ke tajurbaat ne ise ghalat sabit kiya.
